groups.assertion: Exact safe finite artifacts, exact owner, full writes/fsync/readback/two matching membership snapshots => source observation only; runtime flags false.
Wrong bytes type/member name/path traversal/casefold alias/too many members/oversize/invalid owner/expired budget refuse before open.
Wrong dev/inode or unsafe/link/reparse directory refuses; later owner swap fails without deleting borrowed files.
Progressive valid short counts complete exact data under same deadline; zero/negative/bool/oversized count or error refuses, preserves partial bytes.
Owned descriptor returned after deadline is retained for exact cleanup, never writes data or retries.
Late write records partial owned effects, refuses next write/readback/publication; cleanup cannot reset budget.
Each error or late return denies source observation; owned partial evidence stays and no removal port exists.
Wrong length/hash, growth/shrink/replacement, failed or late canonical hash refuse under same deadline.
Missing/extra/duplicate/foreign/casefold/symlink/hardlink members or unstable directory/file metadata refuse.
Expiry during/between/after final scans denies success; no deadline recreation.
Extra or too many entries stops at finite bound; enumeration close errors deny and do not trigger unrelated cleanup.
Second invocation on occupied files refuses exclusive-open, cannot overwrite or treat previous partial files as owned.
Wrapper invokes only allocated writer after actual capture using original budget; unreachable missingpins guard retained; all old lifecycle/test bytes unchanged.
Exact final source/receipt hashes and pathdiff; prior failure/source snapshots preserved; no private paths/body or guessed pins.
Only allowed isolated definitions with fake ports; no candidate/native module import/execution and no filesystem/native acceptance claim.
